_comment: NSE equity-segment (Capital Market) trading holidays for 2026. Weekend dates need not be listed. From NSE circular NSE/CMTR/71775 (Ref. 172/2025, 12 Dec 2025, 'Trading Holidays for Calendar Year 2026', 15 weekday holidays) and NSE/CMTR/72260 (Ref. 07/2026, 12 Jan 2026, which added 2026-01-15). First entered from search-index extracts (2026-10-19); on 2026-11-27 both PDFs were opened directly from nsearchives.nseindia.com and every date and name matched. Muhurat trading 2026: Sunday 2026-11-08 (a weekend session; the system does not trade it). The 2027 list was not yet published on 2026-11-27.
source: NSE circulars NSE/CMTR/71775 (2025-12-12) and NSE/CMTR/72260 (2026-01-12), PDFs read directly on 2026-11-27
